subject: Pilot blueprint & approval runway — BrightStride discovery recap
body:
[Full email thread]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@brightstride.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot blueprint & approval runway — BrightStride discovery recap

Hi Alicia — thanks again for the call today. Short recap and proposed mutual action plan so we keep everyone aligned.

Pain points we heard
- Latency spikes on inference during end-of-day batch scoring (current infra peaks at 12s p95)
- Rising per-call cost for embeddings for similarity search (budget pressure for Q3)
- Compliance: data residency needs and audit logs for model usage

Goals you shared
1) Run a focused 6-week pilot to validate throughput/latency improvements and unit cost reduction
2) Prove inference quality parity (NDCG/PR metrics) with your current hosted provider for key prompt sets
3) Get procurement signoff for a predictable reserved capacity option if pilot metrics meet thresholds

Proposed mutual action plan (draft)
- Milestone 1 — Technical deep-dive + test plan
  - Owner (BrightStride): Tom Lee (CTO)
  - Owner (Redwood): Marcus Lin (Solutions Engineer)
  - Target date: 2026-03-24
- Milestone 2 — Pilot environment setup & smoke tests
  - Owner (BrightStride): Engineering lead (TBD)
  - Owner (Redwood): Soojin Lee
  - Target date: 2026-04-07
- Milestone 3 — Procurement & contract review
  - Owner (BrightStride): Jordan Marsh (Procurement)
  - Owner (Redwood): Ben Carter (Sales Ops)
  - Target date: 2026-04-15
- Milestone 4 — Pilot execution (6 weeks) + evaluation
  - Owner (BrightStride): Product/Eng stakeholders
  - Owner (Redwood): Marcus Lin (support)
  - Target date: start 2026-05-01, complete 2026-06-12

Asks / next steps (what I need from you)
- Please review the attached MPA draft and call out any missing stakeholders or conflicting dates
- Confirm who will own the engineering setup on your side (name/email) so we can schedule the deep-dive
- If procurement prefers, share a DOC with common contracting terms you need us to accept

Attachments: BrightStride_MPA_Draft.pdf (draft MPA), SOC2-scoped-evidence.pdf (subset), Procurement_Questions.xlsx

I'll follow up with Marcus to lock the deep-dive — propose Tue 3/23 or Wed 3/24, 30–45 minutes.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

-----

On Thu, 12 Mar 2026 at 17:05, Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@brightstride.com> wrote:

Thanks Soojin — great summary. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Tom Lee will lead the technical deep-dive; he prefers the 24th at 10am PT. I'll cc him when we lock time.
- Procurement point of contact is Jordan Marsh (jordan.marsh@brightstride.com); Jordan will need an initial SOW/price estimate before scheduling legal review.
- For the pilot env, we'll need assurance about data residency (US-only) and a list of audit logs you can provide.

I've attached our procurement intake template (procurement_queue.xlsx) — Jordan will fill in the commercial questions.

Alicia

Alicia Torres
Head of Product Operations
BrightStride
alicia.torres@brightstride.com | +1 (617) 555-0103

-----

On Fri, 13 Mar 2026 at 09:12, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:

Thanks Alicia — copying Marcus and Ben.

Marcus: Tom confirmed 2026-03-24 10:00 PT for the deep-dive. Can you prepare a 20-minute technical agenda (infrastructure overview, test harness, data handling, expected metrics) + a short checklist of what we'll need from their infra team? If you can also include expected tokens/sec and a target p95 latency we plan to demonstrate, that'll help procurement scope the SOW.

Ben: Jordan will need a price range for a committed Dedicated pool (monthly commit) vs hosted burst model so procurement can decide what path to run in parallel. Can you draft two price options and include minimum term and SLA bullets?

I've uploaded the MPA draft to a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AxiMPA-placeholder — feel free to add comments directly.

I'll send calendar invites once Marcus confirms agenda.

— Soojin

-----

On Sun, 15 Mar 2026 at 11:03, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:

Appreciate the recap. Quick notes from Sales Ops:

- I'll prepare two commercial sketches by EOD Mon 3/16: (a) 6-month reserved capacity (monthly commit) with preferential pricing, (b) hosted-on-demand with burst credits and no commit. Include an estimated savings delta for 50M tokens/month baseline.
- Marcus — I'll need a short quant (expected tokens/sec and expected p50/p95) to include in the pricing assumptions. Can you drop those into the shared Drive doc under /commercial-inputs?
- I'll also add a procurement checklist (standard redlines we accept, required SLAs, and data residency language) to the Drive for Jordan.

If we get procurement's intake back by 3/18, legal can aim to turn a preliminary SOW by 4/01.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

[End thread]
